core: Enteric neural crest and gut development
qualifier: endothelin signalling, including arterial morphogenesis and blood pressure
name: Endothelin signalling in enteric neural crest and arteries
rationale: Members combine endothelin receptor signalling with enteric nervous system/neural crest and midgut development; unlike the GDNF/RET, GI smooth-muscle and sympathoadrenal confusables, this theme adds endothelin control of artery morphogenesis and systemic blood pressure.

qualifier: mesenchyme-to-epithelial tubule formation
name: Early metanephric development via mesenchyme-to-epithelial tubule formation
rationale: All members concern early metanephric kidney formation (nephric duct, ureteric bud elongation, renal vesicle, metanephric mesenchyme), distinguished from confusables (ureteric bud induction, S-shaped body/segment patterning, negative growth control) by mesenchymal maintenance, MET and tubule epithelial differentiation.

core: Transcriptional control of triglyceride and glucose homeostasis
qualifier: LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) and SREBP
name: LXR and SREBP regulation of triglyceride and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are LXR/SREBP-driven gene programmes and regulation of triglyceride synthesis, fatty acid homeostasis and gluconeogenesis; confusables instead centre on PPARG adipogenesis, glucagon/PKA, PPARA or circadian nuclear receptors and lack SREBP and gluconeogenesis control.

qualifier: EGFR and ERBB2 rather than ERBB3/ERBB4
name: EGFR and ERBB2 downstream effector signalling
rationale: Members are effector events (PLCG1, GRB2, GRB7, SHC1, PI3K, GAB1, PTK6, motility) downstream of EGFR and ERBB2, whereas confusables are ERBB2-ERBB4 and ERBB3 signalling events.

qualifier: axon sprouting and regeneration combined with myelination
name: Axon sprouting, regeneration and glial myelination
rationale: Members span axon growth inhibition/stimulation, collateral and injury-induced sprouting, regeneration and CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance by glia; confusables cover only Sema3A axon guidance, nodal adhesion, or glial fate without the regeneration plus myelination combination.

qualifier: skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
name: Basement membrane matrix in skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members concern basement membrane assembly (laminins, collagen trimers, syndecans, proteoglycans, dystroglycan complex) together with myogenesis and neuromuscular synapse assembly, which the hemidesmosome and collagen-fibril confusables lack.

core: G1/S progression and DNA replication initiation
qualifier: E2F targets and replication origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transition and replication origin licensing
rationale: Members are E2F target programmes, proliferating T-cell modules and ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly at G1/S; confusables focus on DREAM repression, G2/M, intra-S checkpoints or break-induced replication.

qualifier: AMP/IMP to inosine degradation
name: Purine ribonucleotide degradation through IMP and inosine
rationale: All four members describe catabolism of AMP/IMP and inosine (ribo-purines), distinct from the deoxyribonucleotide catabolism and purine salvage confusables.

qualifier: guanine-N7
name: tRNA guanine-N7 methylation
rationale: Members are tRNA methylation, RNA guanine-N7 methylation and its tRNA-stabilising regulatory effect, distinguishing it from aminoacylation, pseudouridylation and mitochondrial RNA modification confusables.

qualifier: lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly and N-glycan processing
name: Congenital disorders of N-linked glycan assembly and processing
rationale: All members are CDG defects in building (ALG, DPAGT1, RFT1, MPDU1, PMM2, MPI, DOLK, SRD5A3) or processing (MGAT2, B4GALT1) N-glycans, whereas confusables centre on dolichol-phosphate mannose, GDP-mannose and GPI anchor defects.

core: L1-family and NCAM cell adhesion signalling
qualifier: axonal node and paranode organisation
name: L1-family and NCAM adhesion in axonal node organisation
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions with ankyrin, paranodal junction assembly and sodium channel clustering for conduction; confusables add DSCAM/nectin adhesion, myelination or gap junctions instead of L1 recycling/signalling and NCAM1.

core: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation
qualifier: inherited neurometabolic defects (adrenoleukodystrophy, spastic paraplegias, CTX)
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and neurometabolic defects
rationale: Members are peroxisomal alpha/beta and omega fatty acid oxidation of medium-to-very-long and branched chains plus the inherited disorders ALD, SPG5A/42/56 and CTX; confusables add peroxisome biogenesis, sterol/bile acid synthesis or PUFA metabolism instead of these disease defects.

qualifier: formin and IQGAP effectors
name: Rho GTPase cycles with formin and IQGAP effectors
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/G/J/U/V, CDC42 and RAC3 with formin and IQGAP activation and focal adhesion disassembly; confusables feature RND2/3, RHOF or RAC1/2-WAVE lamellipodia instead.

qualifier: IIIb/IIIc splice isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoform ligand binding and activation
rationale: Members cover ligand binding by FGFR1/2 b and c isoforms, FGFR2 alternative splicing and activating point mutants, unlike confusables dominated by downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades or FGFR3/4.

qualifier: glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte differentiation
name: Glial fate specification, differentiation and CNS myelination
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, oligodendrocyte and astrocyte differentiation and proliferation, gliosis and CNS myelination; confusables emphasise axon regeneration, astrocyte activation or peripheral myelin/nodal organisation rather than glial fate choice.

qualifier: biogenesis and RISC assembly
name: MicroRNA biogenesis and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: All three members describe core miRNA production, RISC loading and small-RNA silencing, whereas confusables cover regulation of miRNA processing/decay or target-specific translational control.

core: Peptide hormone GPCR control of adenylate cyclase
qualifier: glucagon-family and somatostatin receptors regulating growth hormone release
name: Glucagon-family and somatostatin receptor cAMP signalling
rationale: Members are glucagon-family and somatostatin GPCR signalling, adenylate cyclase activation and growth hormone secretion (the GHRH/somatostatin axis), distinct from feeding behaviour, GH receptor/JAK-STAT and insulin-secretion confusables.

qualifier: glycinergic inhibitory synaptic transmission
name: Motor coordination and locomotion with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, postural and proprioceptive behaviours with cerebellar and neuronal components, and uniquely glycinergic transmission, hyperekplexia (GlyT2) and dampening of nerve impulse transmission absent from all confusables.

qualifier: scavenger receptor classes A, B, F and H
name: Scavenger receptor-mediated recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover phosphatidylserine exposure, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and neutrophils plus class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors, whereas confusables lack the scavenger classes or the apoptotic-cell recognition steps.

qualifier: collagen, elastin and hyaluronan catabolism with protease control
name: Extracellular matrix degradation of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan
rationale: Members are MMP activation, endopeptidase regulation and catabolism of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan; confusables cover collagen/elastic fibre synthesis or fibrinolysis and lack hyaluronan turnover.

qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and creatine phosphotransfer
name: Nucleoside transport and nucleotide phosphotransfer, including mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members combine plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase and analogue-drug transport with nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, creatine phosphotransfer and mitochondrial ADP/ATP carrier function, which confusables (NUDT/thiopurine, xenobiotic efflux, NAD metabolism) lack.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress induction
name: Stress-induced cellular senescence and UV response
rationale: Members regulate stress- and oxidative-induced senescence, fibroblast arrest and p53 signalling together with UV response programmes, which oncogene-induced senescence, SASP and p53-apoptosis confusables lack.

qualifier: scaRNA, telomerase RNA and protein targeting
name: RNA and protein targeting to Cajal bodies
rationale: Members concern localisation of scaRNA, telomerase RNA and proteins to Cajal bodies (with RNA folding), distinct from telomere extension and snoRNA modification confusables.

qualifier: microbial modulation
name: Necroptotic cell death and its microbial modulation
rationale: Members are necroptotic signalling and its positive/negative regulation, including microbial and SARS-CoV-1 effects on RIPK1-mediated death, whereas confusables centre on apoptotic execution or death-receptor/caspase-8 signalling.

qualifier: guidance-associated extension and collateral sprouting
name: Axon extension control in guidance and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members regulate axon extension during guidance, chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting; confusables carry Sema3A/netrin guidance signalling but lack the collateral sprouting members.
